Nav

The main content region is the primary task area of the page, distinct from chrome like navigation.

It usually scrolls independently of surrounding fixed regions.

A third paragraph makes that scrolling behaviour visible when the height is constrained.

And a fourth, so there is genuinely more to scroll through.
